Maya Patel: Heads-up: planning a short bring-up rehearsal for client ZenithLabs' reserved pool (zenith-resv-07) Wed 02:00 UTC. Purpose: run a controlled spike + validate quota fallback and manual rollback steps. Low blast radius, customer aware.
Noah Grant: I can own the traffic harness. Plan: 2m canary at 2k rps, then 3x spikes to 18k rps (chat-heavy) with 30s spacing. Will push k6 script to infra/loadtests/zenith and tag requests X-run:1865432100.
Samira Khan: I'll monitor autoscaler events, GPU alloc logs, and per-tenant throttles. Temp alerts I'll add: "sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[1m])) by (pool) > 3000" and "avg(gpu_utilization) by (pool) > 0.9".
ops-bot: Preflight OK: pool=zenith-resv-07, gpus=12, headroom=20%, no maintenance locks.
Maya Patel: Dry-run Friday 01:30 UTC (10m) to validate certs and access. Roles: Noah=load, Samira=monitor, Rory=customer comms, Maya=orchestration/rollback.
Rory Mills: Notified Zenith PMs. They want a quick post-run note and samples if anything looks off.
Noah Grant: Harness will disable warmers to force cold starts and inject 1% malformed prompts to exercise error handling.
Samira Khan: Rollback play: 1) pause new route, 2) enable fallback policy 'shed-embeds-first', 3) scale down new instances by 25%. I have the k8s drain steps ready.
Maya Patel: Final checklist before dry-run: stop warmers, push temp alerts, set quota policy to 'shed-80pct', confirm billing & post-run sample collector. We'll reconfirm 2h before. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
